title: rewrite README positioning to lead with 'leash for AI agents'
task_body: The README opening drifted into feature lists. Rewrite the top section so the product positioning — Convergio is the leash for AI agents — is the first thing a reader sees, with the technical details below.
rationale: Historically-failed retrieval case: product/positioning copy changes frequently retrieve the wrong docs because many markdown files share overlapping tokens. README is the edited surface; AGENTS.md anchors the canonical one-paragraph positioning + constraints.
